title: Yearning Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A slow‑cooked, savory Moroccan chicken tagine with green curry paste, dried apricots, and almonds, served over a slate tile for a romantic, aromatic experience.
instructions: Heat the slate tile over medium heat and add olive oil.
Place the chicken thighs skin side down and sear until golden brown, then flip and sear the other side.
Add sliced onion to the tile and cook until translucent, stirring occasionally.
Stir in minced garlic and green curry paste until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Pour in chicken broth, add the cinnamon stick, salt, pepper, and preserved lemon strips, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Return the seared chicken to the tile, nestle the apricots around the pieces, and cover with a tight‑fitting lid.
Reduce heat to low and let the tagine cook for 45 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Remove the lid, break the cinnamon stick, and stir in toasted almonds.
Let the dish rest off‑heat for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.
